name: N^3-Tree with Mipmapped Bricks
definition: A rendering method using an $N^3$-tree (generalized octree) where each node stores a single pointer to child nodes (in a node pool texture) or a brick/constant value. Interior nodes store brick pointers to enable high-quality filtering via mipmaps. The structure is mirrored on the CPU for updates, but rendering and visibility are unified on the GPU.
summary: N^3-Tree with Mipmapped Bricks renders volumetric data using an adaptive tree and mipmapped bricks, reducing memory usage by storing a single pointer per node instead of eight.
